units.source_text: 他想吐一口唾沫，又慌忙停住了。

en.t: He was about to spit, but hurriedly stopped himself.

units.source_text: 即使仅含有一点水气的东西，也必须让它还原到身体中去。

en.t: Anything that contained even the slightest moisture had to be returned to his body.

units.source_text: 唇齿之间，沙子与唾沫分离，他用手指把牙齿上沾着的沙子抠了出来。

en.t: Between his lips and teeth, the sand separated from the saliva, and he used his finger to pick the sand stuck to his teeth out.
